narrative.overview:
The launcher is a well-made household appliance in the Braun line (SK4, ET66, T3): a warm-grey moulded housing, legends printed in dark ink, and one signal orange reserved for the single live thing on screen. Every panel is either a raised housing face or a well pressed into one; nothing floats as glass, nothing is tinted by the wallpaper, and the home screen leaves the user's wallpaper untouched: the clock, its legend, the page grille and the dock icons sit directly on it, with no dock body by default. App icons keep their own designs under the system mask; the launcher does not force a shape on them.

Density is that of a control panel used hundreds of times a day, one-handed: few elements, each with a clear legend, nothing hidden behind a mystery gesture. The look refuses Material You tonal pills and iOS frosted glass. Those looks (wallpaper colour, glass dock, glass drawer, blur) remain available as non-default settings, but they are user options, not this system.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque warm-grey housing in light and night variants; no blur by default.
Recessed wells (search slot, dock channel, icon circles, sheet grip) shaded dark under the top edge and catching light on the lower lip.
Raised faces (menus, folder windows, drawer sheet, and the optional housing dock) with a 1dp machined rim: light along the top, shade along the bottom.
Legends in small tracked capitals; one large light clock.
The signal dot: one orange point that marks what is live.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange marks the live thing on a surface. If two things on screen claim it, one of them is not live.

rules.name: The Ink Not Accent Rule
rules.body: Where Material would colour a control with the accent (dialog buttons, section headers, the caret), the Appliance prints it in legend ink.

rules.name: The Printed Legend Rule
rules.body: A label that names a part of the appliance (section, tile, glance line) is set uppercase, medium weight, tracked 0.1em or wider. Content (app names, settings titles, summaries) stays in sentence case.

rules.name: The Raised or Recessed Rule
rules.body: Every surface is a face or a well. Rims and well shading are the only gradients; there is no decorative gradient, no glow, no blur in the default look.

dos: **Do** build every panel as a raised face or a well, with the 1dp rim on faces and the inner top shade on wells.
**Do** mark the live thing with a signal dot (5-6dp) or a signal-tinted glyph, and keep it to one per surface.
**Do** print part names as uppercase legends, 0.1em tracking or wider, medium weight.
**Do** leave the default dock bare on the wallpaper; when the housing dock is chosen, keep it 14dp in from the screen edges.
**Do** keep the drawer sheet 12dp below the status bar.
**Do** show app icons in their own system-masked shapes by default.
**Do** use switch green only for a toggle that is on.
donts: **Don't** set text in signal orange or fill a container with it.
**Don't** colour controls with an accent where legend ink will do: dialog buttons, section headers and the caret stay ink.
**Don't** add gradients beyond rim and well shading, or blur, to the default look; glass stays an opt-in setting.
**Don't** use Material You tonal pill containers for selection; a selected item is a raised key with a dot.
